payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the layer norm approximation significantly impacts performance, particularly causing a reduction of 1.08% in the average performance of THE-X compared to the baseline model.

claims.text: The layer norm approximation incurs a performance reduction of 1.08% on average, which is the most significant drop among the approximation components.
Jointly finetuning the softmax estimation model and approximated layernorm leads to a performance drop across all tasks, indicating their critical role in performance.
The approximation error tends to accumulate when the transformer stacks with too many layers, further affecting performance.
